capabilities: Sync vault files and .obsidian settings two-way with Proton Drive
Detect three-way conflicts and keep the losing side as a conflict copy
Browse, compare and restore earlier Drive versions of a note
Exclude paths by glob and skip large files or cellular data
Stop mass deletions with a confirmation guard
disambiguation: Not a developer SDK; it is a sync plugin built on Proton's Drive SDK.
extras: Not yet in the community directory; install manually or via BRAT. The plugin writes to and can delete files in the vault, and has no external audit, so the README advises keeping a restorable backup. No telemetry and no paid tiers. GPL-3.0-or-later.
intentEvidence: This is a maintained fork of MarckFp/obsidian-proton-sync
motivation: The fork exists because the upstream project stopped merging fixes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep a vault in sync with Proton Drive, and general file sync tools do not handle Obsidian renames, conflicts or settings.

relations.evidence: This is a maintained fork of MarckFp/obsidian-proton-sync
Two-way sync between an Obsidian vault and a folder in Proton Drive
With BRAT you can add ondreu/proton-sdk-sync instead

summary: Two-way, end-to-end encrypted sync between an Obsidian vault and a Proton Drive folder, built on Proton's official Drive SDK.
